BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Your questions.
Considered.

A practical starting point for your led & solar lighting enquiry.

Can LED luminaires be fitted to existing lighting poles?

A retrofit depends on the condition and suitability of the poles, brackets, wiring and controls. The replacement luminaire also needs to meet the lighting design. An equipment review helps establish whether a direct replacement or a wider upgrade is needed.

Is solar lighting suitable for every site?

Suitability depends on available sunlight, shading, the lighting schedule, battery requirements and the intended application. Share the site layout and operating brief so these factors can be reviewed before selecting a system.

How can potential energy savings be assessed?

Compare the existing and proposed equipment ratings, operating hours and control strategy while maintaining the required lighting performance. A useful estimate states these assumptions clearly instead of relying on a general savings percentage.
